## Mesh humanoid (`piper_rl/hazard/assets/hrg_human/`)

The 47 meshes are byte-identical to the files in the human-robot-gym submodule
at the commit above (checked with `cmp`); `human.xml` was edited (texture paths,
debug sites hidden, root rotated to z-up, mocap flag removed).

- human-robot-gym ships no LICENSE file, so there is no verified grant to
  redistribute these files. The MIT classifier in its `pyproject.toml` is not a
  licence text.
- The human-robot-gym assets README states the models "are taken from
  https://github.com/KlabCMU/kin-poly" (verified in the submodule). The
  repository owner's note in `ATTRIBUTION.md` adds that kin-poly's meshes are
  SMPL neutral-body segments, which carry a non-commercial licence
  (https://smpl.is.tue.mpg.de). That SMPL claim has not been independently
  verified here.
- Used for figure rendering (`piper_rl/scripts/render_tasks.py`) only.
  Before any commercial use, or if the repository stays public and the licence
  question matters, replace the meshes or obtain written permission.

## Knife scene files

`agilex_piper/piper_knife.xml` and `agilex_piper/piper_human_knife_task.xml` are
generated by `piper_rl/scripts/make_knife_scene.py` from this repository's own
`piper.xml` (Menagerie-derived, MIT, see `agilex_piper/LICENSE`),
`piper_task.xml` and `piper_human_task.xml`.

## Python packages (not vendored)

Listed in `requirements-sharp-tools.txt` (core) and
`requirements-sharp-tools-rl.txt` (constrained-RL stack, separate environment).

## Future work only, not vendored

ReDMan, Bi-DexHands, DiSECt, SliceIt!, and all datasets. See
`docs/sharp_tools/THIRD_PARTY.md`.
